qualified_via="Host-place fallback — highest non-qualified nation, since the USA cannot reach the top 15 (PROVISIONAL)" stored in Standings, but la28-cricket-w is managed by the Qualified tab and the loader derives these columns from it — the stored value is never read and can silently disagree. Clear the cell(s); Qualified is the single source.
threshold for "Seven FOPQT places on ranking" (TOP_N_OF_POOL) cannot be located: its ranking has zero standings rows captured. Extend the Standings capture for fiba-mens-world-ranking to unblock it.

threshold for "Host place test — rank 15 or better" resolves at rank 15 — exactly the captured depth of icc-mens-t20i-team-ranking. Zero headroom: the next standings refresh that moves the edge team down will make this cut unlocatable. Capture more rows now.
